text: I must remember to retrieve the (few) rations from the Restroom (upstairs) and see them conveyed to the Apartments: [Hildebrand] [Timm] [ArgoAndIsobel] [Sigga] [Makenna] It is most probable that one or more comrades shall go without sustenance this day. A most singular prospect indeed.
I ought to pay a call upon FLAT26. By this hour, Argo should have been awake for quite some time.

The Argo family does not answer the call--no crying, no arguing. And yet, I could swear I heard a thud coming from FLAT26. Perhaps I should ask Makenna for a spare key, just to make sure everything is in order.
I need to check what’s under those bed sheets. Juno, help me.
I heard a noise coming from the bathroom. If the killer is still here, I must act with firmness and vigor.
Sigga asked me to get some Coagulant for one of her customary psychotropic concoctions. Ecgberth is hiding it somewhere in his chamber.
When Ecgberth discovers that it is missing from his drawer, he will surely be displeased with Voitsehk. Better that than Sigga going through withdrawal.
Incredibly, Ecgberth handed over the Coagulant of his own free will. I should deliver it to Sigga before he causes any trouble.
I delivered the Coagulant to Sigga. One less problem to deal with.
What a shambles is this place? Where are the Argos?
